decision.scope: The Kani bounded-verification lane at its provisioning + scaffolding scope: the committed pin (kani-version.toml: kani 0.68.0 / CBMC 6.11.0 / bundled nightly 2026-08-21), the `just verify` recipe and lane script (scripts/check-kani-lane.sh: per-harness three-valued outcomes over a 300 s wall budget, pin check, no-silent-drop cross-check), eleven partitioned proof harnesses in crates/catherine-core (panic-freedom per check family, the diff-stable sortedness invariant, five witness-soundness obligations re-evaluated independently of the kernel walk), the provocation machinery (scripts/provoke-kani-harnesses.sh: one anchored seed per harness), and the nightly workflow (.github/workflows/verify.yml). `model_hashes` are plain sha256 digests of the file bytes of the two normative spec files the harness obligations rest on, named in full: openspec/specs/kernel-checks/spec.md (sha256:20626a12…) and openspec/specs/findings/spec.md (sha256:d477ca3c…); they are file digests, not canonical-model re-encodings.
decision.rationale: Hold: nothing proved, nothing bought, and the wall is measured — extending would multiply unverifiable spend against it. Executed evidence: the whole-walk harness at unwind 32 ran 43 minutes without completing; a build-only harness at unwind 16 ran 13 minutes without completing; per-family minimal-bounds partitioning (7-12 symbolic cells) did not change the shape of the run; a controlled probe with NO catherine code — four concrete String-keyed BTreeMap inserts plus one kani::any::<u8> assert — also did not complete within minutes on 16 cores / 60 GB, its trace being memcmp unrolling to the unwind cap inside the String-comparison model. Conclusion: Kani 0.68's model of String-keyed std BTreeMap operations dominates the symbolic execution at every harness granularity this lane tried; the cost is kernel-side heap modeling (Ident(String) keys, BTreeMap-shaped tables are the kernel's API surface), not harness-side input modeling. Phase-2 families (taxonomy disjointness, search honesty) were therefore NOT written — hold funds nothing further. The provocation pass is blocked by the same wall (a counterexample needs the same exploration a proof needs); the per-harness seeded machinery is landed so it runs the day the wall clears. Defects found: zero — nothing ran to completion, so the lane observed no kernel behavior beyond compilation (which is clean under the bundled nightly: cargo check green on both kernel crates). Harness-design lesson recorded in docs/kani-lane.md's bounds comment: a one-row cospan target makes the pullback commutes verdict vacuous (both compositions always agree) — non-vacuity is a property of the bounded space, caught by reading, not by a tool. Revisit triggers: (1) a Kani release bump whose String/BTreeMap models stop unrolling memcmp to the unwind cap — re-run the four-insert probe before any harness; (2) a kernel-side ident-interning change (usize keys internally, Ident at the API edge), which would be its own beads ticket and would make the walk model-checkable. Hold keeps the scaffold maintained and honest: undetermined is loud per harness, dispositions are recorded in docs/kani-lane.md, nothing is cited as proved, and the lane never enters `just ci`. Retire would discard the only exhaustive-within-bounds machinery the project has for the day the toolchain clears; extend would fund phase-2 harnesses against the same measured wall.
decision.fixture_only_comparison: What fixture-and-property assurance already covers at this commit: the fixture-corpus parity oracle samples every check-applicable document (the Lean gate's lean-parity run: divergences 0) and hegel samples generated inputs — both nets green in the 5b3f1aa gates. What Kani would add when it runs: exhaustive-within-bounds statements over adversarial typed documents no corpus enumerates (panic/overflow-freedom of build + check walk; witness soundness re-evaluated independently of the walk). What it bought this session: nothing executable — zero completed proofs, zero observed kernel defects; the session's measurable output is the impracticality evidence itself, recorded with timings in docs/kani-lane.md. CI assurance is unchanged either way: the lane lives outside `just ci` and runs only in the nightly verify workflow.
